'''Stealth boots''' were combat footwear used by [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]]. They had to be maintained, and checked for malfunctions after every mission.<ref name="ROE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref>
